title: Alert on any sign-in by a break-glass account
summary: Log search alert query for emergency access accounts: every sign-in, successful or not, should page someone.
notes: Match on object ID (UserId), not UPN: a renamed account keeps its object ID.
Test the alert when you do your regular break-glass sign-in test.
